source.name: AstroGuide comet close-encounter pipeline
source.cometFrame: Geocentric apparent equatorial RA/Dec samples from the cometSnapshot ephemeris, linearly interpolated between source sample timestamps.
source.targetFrame: Catalog J2000 equatorial RA/Dec held fixed during the scan.
source.closestApproachAlgorithm: Detect local angular-separation minima on the cometSnapshot sample grid for static targets and on the dynamic Moon/planet sample grid for dynamic targets, refine each bracket on a finer grid, then apply quadratic time interpolation.
source.eventIDAlgorithm: Stable comet ID plus companion ID plus UTC closest-approach date.
source.cometMagnitudeModel: Interpolated apparent magnitude from the cometSnapshot sample row when finite.
source.ephemerisSource: JPL Development Ephemeris loaded through Skyfield
source.dynamicBodyFrame: Geocentric apparent equatorial RA/Dec for Moon and planets from Skyfield earth.at(t).observe(body).apparent().
source.moonMagnitudeModel: Approximate visual magnitude from lunar phase angle; intended for context.

cometCandidateFilter.magnitudePolicy: When maxCometMagnitude is unset, all cometSnapshot streams are eligible, including faint curated comets.

dsoCandidateFilter.curatedRecommendationUnion: seasonal recommendation priorityTier=1 plus target metadata overlay

ranking.limitStrategy: Unlimited by default; when capped, keep smallest separations per comet with UTC time and ID as deterministic tie-breakers.

payloadFormat.participantModel: Ordered generic participants: comet first, then deep-sky target, Moon, or major planet.

notes: Events preserve true UTC closest-approach instants. App clients should group by local night and apply site observability filters at display time.
Comet positions are interpolated from the deterministic cometSnapshot ephemeris cadence; this is a planning metadata proof point, not a replacement for precision Horizons queries.
DSO-to-DSO events are intentionally not generated because static catalog targets do not move relative to each other.
